note: Synthetic: null rejection rates of the H1 and H2b score tests on simulated sessions of the E1 plans, for calibrating min_events before the E1 preregistration; not model results or real-world results.
rule: min_events is the smallest bin lower edge at and above which every per-family cell with at least 2000 computed tests has a null rejection rate (p < 0.05) within [0.03, 0.07] for both tests in every scenario that feeds them (the per-family fits are the confirmatory hazard tests, DECISIONS.md D-060); 0 when every such cell does; null when no deciding bin lies above a failing cell. Pooled cells and both scopes together are judged the same way for reference (deciding: false) and decide nothing
